chars.K: KHADIJA: a young woman wearing a beige hijab-style headscarf wrapped around her round head, a mustard-yellow blazer over a white blouse and dark grey trousers.
chars.Y: YASSINE: a slim man wearing a burgundy polo shirt, a shiny silver wristwatch, dark jeans and white sneakers.
chars.S: SALMA: a young woman wearing a bright red leather jacket over a black top, a short denim skirt, big gold hoop earrings and red ankle boots.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At the open front door of a modern apartment in Rabat, KHADIJA warmly welcomes SALMA who arrives pulling a pink suitcase; behind KHADIJA, YASSINE leans in the hallway staring at SALMA with a sly interested look while SALMA glances back at him. Tension, evening light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a cozy Moroccan living room with sedari cushions and mint tea, KHADIJA and SALMA sit very close on the sofa, KHADIJA whispering a secret into SALMA's ear while SALMA smiles slyly, looking away with a hidden scheming expression.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the apartment kitchen, SALMA holds KHADIJA's hands and talks to her seriously with a fake caring face, as if telling her to leave her husband; KHADIJA looks confused and sad.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At a busy Rabat street cafe terrace, YASSINE sits laughing flirtatiously with a woman in a green dress (seen from behind) at a small table with coffee cups, touching her hand, cars and palm trees in the background.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the apartment entrance at night, SALMA pulls a guilty-looking YASSINE by the arm back inside towards KHADIJA, who stands with arms crossed, angry but softening. SALMA smiles as if she is the peacemaker.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a modern open-plan office in Rabat, KHADIJA sits at her desk in front of a computer, tired and in pain, one hand on her lower belly, grabbing her handbag to leave early; colleagues' empty desks around.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a quiet apartment building corridor, KHADIJA stands at her own front door holding her key near the lock, frozen, turning her head toward the door because she hears a sound from inside, suspicious expression.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside the dim apartment hallway, KHADIJA tiptoes and presses her ear against a closed bedroom door, a thin line of warm light under the door, a man's sneakers and red ankle boots lying on the floor near the door. Suspense.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close view of KHADIJA in the dark hallway in front of the closed bedroom door, both hands over her mouth in shock, eyes wide, her handbag falling from her shoulder to the floor. Dramatic shadows.
